description: This file defines an abstract class BaseDumper in the Twig Profiler component, responsible for representing profiling data as a string. It includes methods for dumping profile information, with some abstract methods for formatting template and non-template profiling segments.

classes.name: BaseDumper
classes.description: An abstract class for dumping profiling data, providing the core logic to traverse and format profiling profiles.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the provided profile by invoking dumpProfile.

methods.name: formatTemplate
methods.description: Abstract method to format a profile that represents a template.

methods.name: formatNonTemplate
methods.description: Abstract method to format a profile that does not represent a template.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Abstract method to format the timing information of a profile.

methods.name: dumpProfile
methods.description: Recursively traverses a Profile object and generates a formatted string representation, handling root, template, and non-template profiles.
